# `/mail-from-attributes` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### PUT /mail-from-attributes/v1

`putMailFromAttributesV1` — Change mail from domain

Change the MAIL FROM domain of an AWS SES email identity and provide the MX and TXT records to be placed in the caller's DNS

- Scopes: sp:notification-mail-from-attributes:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): mailfromattributesdto
- Returns 200: mailfromattributes

### GET /mail-from-attributes/v1/{identity}

`getMailFromAttributesV1` — Get mail from attributes

Retrieve MAIL FROM attributes for a given AWS SES identity.

- Scopes: sp:notification-mail-from-attributes:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `identity` (path, required) — Returns the MX and TXT record to be put in your DNS, as well as the MAIL FROM domain status
- Returns 200: mailfromattributes
